title: University of Houston researchers find western harvester ants exhibit reversed aging
digest: University of Houston researchers reported that western harvester ant colonies exhibit reversed aging, with lower mortality and higher reproductive rates over 34 years of tracking 3,285 colonies. The study attributes this phenomenon to continuous replacement of older workers and larger colony sizes enhancing survival and reproductive capacity, challenging traditional individual-based aging theories. However, the findings remain un peer-reviewed and unreplicated, with no specific methodology details or statistical significance provided in the Phys.org report.

representative.title: University of Houston 研究发现蚂蚁群体呈现逆衰老现象
representative.summary: University of Houston 研究团队发现，西方收获蚁群体在年龄增长过程中死亡风险降低且繁殖率上升。该研究基于34年对3285个蚁群的跟踪观测，揭示社会昆虫的衰老机制与个体不同——蚁群通过持续更换工蚁维持年轻状态，且规模扩大的群体生存概率更高，繁殖能力更强。
